name: Group Header 111
definition: Set of characteristics shared by all individual transactions included in the message.

MessageIdentification.name: Message Identification
MessageIdentification.definition: Point to point reference assigned by the instructing party and sent to the next party in the chain to unambiguously identify the message.||Usage: The instructing party has to make sure that 'MessageIdentification' is unique per instructed party for a pre-agreed period.

CreationDateTime.name: Creation Date Time
CreationDateTime.definition: Date and time at which the status report was created by the instructing party.

InitiatingParty.name: Initiating Party
InitiatingParty.definition: Party initiating the creditor payment activation request. This can either be the creditor himself or the party that initiates the request on behalf of the creditor.

ForwardingAgent.name: Forwarding Agent
ForwardingAgent.definition: Financial institution that receives the instruction from the initiating party and forwards it to the next agent in the payment chain for execution.

DebtorAgent.name: Debtor Agent
DebtorAgent.definition: Financial institution servicing an account for the debtor.

CreditorAgent.name: Creditor Agent
CreditorAgent.definition: Financial institution servicing an account for the creditor.
